definitionZh: 背景过滤 CSS 属性允许您应用图形效果, 如模糊或颜色转换到元素后面的区域 。 因为它适用于元素背后的一切,要看到该元素或其背景的效果需要透明或部分透明.
sourceDefinition: The backdrop-filter CSS property lets you apply graphical effects such as blurring or color shifting to the area behind an element. Because it applies to everything behind the element, to see the effect the element or its background needs to be transparent or partially transparent.
